samples.rationale: Fits the catalog: matching lives in derived repository finders (VetRepository findDistinctBySpecialtiesNameIgnoreCase, paged and collection), the controller only binds and delegates, and pagination links use the framework URL builder. Debit: normalize() puts the blank/strip rule in the controller, unit-untestable without booting the web layer, widening the pyramid gap; absence is represented twice ("" then null at VetController model.addAttribute). Tests are behavior-named and reuse helen(), and ClinicServiceTests exercises real data for case-insensitivity, partial-name rejection, and distinct; but the slice tests assert implementation via verify(never()).findAll(...) rather than observable output, lean on Mockito stubs (making "only Helen" tautological), and bare "radiology"/"Leary" literals are mystery values. Docs move broadly (ADR, NG-9, REQ-VET-003, defect row); the Vets contract row still reads Implements "—", and no open question was recorded.

Filtering lands in the repository as derived queries (findDistinctBySpecialtiesNameIgnoreCase, paged and collection forms sharing one property path), leaving VetController as a thin adapter; the blank-to-absent normalize() mirrors owner search, though the empty-string sentinel plus filter.isEmpty() branching is duplicated across showVetList and showResourcesVetList. Templates switch to @{/vets.html(page=..., specialty=...)}, which correctly omits a null filter. Tests are BDD-named and phase-separated, but several assert implementation detail via verify(this.vets, never()).findAll(...) rather than observable output, and specialties ("radiology", "surgery") and jsonPath id value(2) are bare mystery literals against the three-tier convention. Docs are thorough: NG-9 narrowed, REQ-VET-003 minted, ADR indexed, defect row dropped; the Vets contract row still reads Implements "—" despite now serving the supported JSON surface.
